emails.subject: Quick question on technical sourcing
emails.body:
Hi Sam,

I am building Hirelix, an early AI sourcing tool for technical recruiters and independent headhunters.

I noticed People In AI's focus on AI engineering, ML, data engineering, MLOps, and robotics roles. That is exactly the kind of technical search where recruiters need more than keyword matching.

Hirelix turns a role brief into an evidence-backed shortlist of real technical profiles, with fit reasons, risks to verify, and outreach-ready context.

Would you be open to giving blunt feedback on whether this would help with a real AI or software role?

Best,
Noah

Noah Jiang
Founder, Hirelix
https://hirelix.online

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}

I am building Hirelix, an early AI sourcing tool for technical recruiters.

Recruiting from Scratch's positioning around AI-native startups, senior software engineers, and software-driven recruiting stood out to me.
